name: a-branch-checkout-naming-no-keel-path-is-allowed
description: Ordinary git flow: `git checkout <branch>` names no .keel/ path anywhere in its text, so the new rule has nothing to match and never reaches it - it is not read as a restore against a protected path just because `checkout` is one of the four restore-semantics subcommands.
